paragraphs: Chapter 657
Episode 167. The Fifth Tomb of Temar (1)
The light emitted by the Sword of Veil gradually changed into the shape of a 'door'. The speed at which the door formed was directly proportional to the amount of spirit energy injected.
Sandra exclaimed that it was the power of hope, while Hedo alternately stared at his sword and the door with a startled look on his face.
'...Could it really be that, as the Black Dragon Murakan said, the Veil is indeed related to ancient Runkandel or Soldieret?'
The blade of the longsword Hedo had acquired long ago by chance had the word 'Veil' engraved on it.
"You… where did you get that sword?"
"That's a strange question, Black Dragon. And from those who had experienced your martial prowess in the Gaifa military road, they said it was not this much."
"Keep that sword well. It seems to have some history with this Murakan. Let's go, kiddo."
On the day when Jin and his party first encountered Hedo at the White Night Tower, Murakan suffered a momentary headache as soon as he saw Hedo's sword, as if some forgotten memory had resurfaced.
Even after they escaped from the Sota Desert, Murakan had tried to recall the memory related to the longsword Veil, but had always failed.
Therefore, the group speculated that Hedo's sword was also an artifact with manipulated history, but no one could have imagined that the Veil would be linked to the Tomb of Temar like this.
"I don't know why it's happening. You used a large amount of spirit energy when you fought me in the past, but there was no reaction like this."
"It must be because the location condition of 'Tomb of Temar' was not met. It seems that your sword is a key to open the tomb. Where did you get that sword?"
"In my youth, I obtained it after defeating a monster in the Black Sea."
"You should tell us more about it later. Anyway, thanks to your sword, there's hope, tower keeper. Thank you."
It was almost a coincidence that Jin brought Hedo on this trip to the Caldron Snowfield.
However, Jin thought that if his sword had a history related to Runkandel, it might not be a coincidence, but destiny.
"12th Ki Master, you plan to go in once the portal is completely formed, right?"
"That's right."
"I'm going in too!"
"You can't, miss."
"You can't, Sandra."
Jin and Hedo spoke at the same time.
"Ah, why!?"
"We don't know what's inside. If there are survivors from Hester, they might have gone in and couldn't come out."

"I agree as well. This is a different issue from coming to the Caldron Snowfield together. If this door leads to the Tomb of Temar, we can't predict anything about what will happen inside. It might mean that escape could be impossible."
"Then are you going in, Jin? You're the only countermeasure against Rosa, what if you die alone inside?"

"The Tomb of Temar is a refuge left by my god and ancestors for Runkandel. I have never been in danger while traveling through those tombs so far. I could also escape at any time I wanted through the spirit energy."
Of course, it's a lie.
Jin had nearly died at the hands of guardians in most of the tombs, and at the fourth tomb, he didn't know how to get out and waited endlessly with Valeria.
But now, since Yuria wasn't there, Sandra had no way of verifying the truth.
Even if it was confirmed, Jin intended to go in alone.
"The duration and situation, I can't predict anything, so I'm worried about what the lady, the devil dragon, and I should do."
"Based on my experience so far, I've been able to reappear within a day or two."
"We can't wait here during that time."
"I know, so return. Unless Rosa comes directly, I can probably escape in any situation."
"I won't go without you!"
"Sandra, please."
Above all, although Jin had become quite close with Sandra, she and Hedo were clearly Jifle's people. He couldn't let them into the Tomb of Temar.
"I still can't do it. So far, the tomb has been friendly, but this time it might be hostile to you, Jin. Hedo and I can be of great help. Moreover, you're already exhausted just by opening the door."
When the door was fully formed, Jin, just as Sandra said, was feeling a great sense of fatigue. Just opening the door had almost completely depleted his spirit energy.
'It seems that the used spirit energy is several times more than what Murakan used for the first tomb.'
Although aura and magic power remained, in case he encountered a difficult opponent inside, Jin couldn't fight at full power.

"And what about the 3rd Ki Master of Runkandel!? Even if the 3rd Ki Master is there when you return, not Rosa, it's a problem. You have to fight the 3rd Ki Master alone, and that too in the middle of enemies."
Runkandel's 3rd Ki Master, Runtia Runkandel.
Ronil had said that she herself led the pursuit team here, following Valeria.
But so far, they hadn't seen Runtia, and the group speculated that she might be among the reinforcements arriving this time.
As Jin tried to step into the door, Sandra threw herself towards it first.
Hedo immediately tried to stop her, but realized a moment later that there was no need.
Thud!
"Uh!"
When Sandra approached, a shockwave erupted from the door, bouncing her back.
It was the same no matter how many times they tried.
"Damn, what is this...! Hedo, try and see if you get pushed away too."
The same phenomenon occurred not only for Sandra but also for Hedo.
He succeeded in approaching the door with superhuman strength, but as soon as he touched it, he couldn't proceed any further as if he was blocked by a wall.
"I think there might be a problem with the door if we proceed further, Miss. Please give up."
On the other hand, no such phenomenon occurred for Jin.
"12th Ki Master."
Jin looked back at Hedo.
"If possible, try to buy at least three days' time inside the tomb. Then we can return and ask for help from Kinzel."
Hedo had concluded that using the commander's dimension door would be the best solution for now.
Jin agreed with this opinion immediately.
"Understood. I will certainly do so if possible."

"Also, when you get out of the tomb, if you happen to return to this cave, immediately release as much energy as possible. We will ask the commander to open the dimension door taking that as a signal."
"You seem to be very quick-witted unlike what you look like, tower keeper. It sounds like a good idea. I think I can feel a little more relieved with that."
"I will have Orugal stand by as soon as possible. Pray for good luck."
"Jin!"
Just as Jin was about to enter the door, Sandra hugged him once more.
"Remember this, in case you're the only one of your companions who comes back to Tikan alive. I will do whatever it takes to kill that person."
Feeling a little dizzy at the seriousness of her words, Jin smiled at Sandra.
"I'll keep that in mind."
As soon as Jin stepped beyond the door.
The light that the longsword Veil was forming immediately went out.
Sandra stared blankly at the spot where Jin had disappeared for a while, and Hedo comforted her by patting her shoulder.
Just like when he entered the abyss of Glik, the sub-space forming the fifth tomb of Temar was filled with only darkness, dim and empty.
"Valeria!"
Even when he shouted her name, not even an echo was heard.
Whether it was because he was in a hurry, or there was another reason, Jin couldn't feel the same comfort in the sub-space of Solderet as before.
'Unlike the tombs I've experienced in the past, I don't feel the spirit energy guiding me. There's no sign of damage by Jifle or other forces, is there another reason?'
There was no other way but to move around himself.
[Meow!]
Shuri emerged from the red gemstone.
Jin immediately started to search the desert-like vast spiritual energy desert by riding Shuri.
The time in the subspace flowed differently from the human world. From what Jin had experienced so far, time in the human world flowed much faster.
'Where are you, Valeria......!'
Just when he was becoming more impatient because there was no progress in his search after about an hour,
Shuri stopped and pointed forward with her front paw.
[Meow, meow-meow!]
There was something transparent like glass emitting light over there. A faint light that seemed about to go out soon.
As he approached, Jin could recognize that it was a piece of magic in the form of a fragment.
It was a fragment of the 'Record Magic'.
<This way......>
'It's a trace left by Valeria......!'
His heart pounded wildly.
Record Magic wasn't only for finding past records, but naturally, it could also be used to leave marks like this.
'Judging by the faint traces, it's either old or it was barely left with hardly any magic left.'
More than anything, the fact that magic remained meant that the caster was still alive.
It was then that Jin could finally let out a sigh of relief for the first time.
'She's not dead. My mentor is definitely still in this subspace.'
Following the direction indicated by Valeria's record magic, Shuri began to run at full speed.
Jin was greatly excited by the fact that he could soon rescue her.
However, as he moved in the direction Valeria had indicated, Jin strangely felt not Valeria's magic power but a displeasing energy getting closer.
It was the energy of chaos. It was purer and larger than what he had felt in the Caldran snowfields and could not be compared qualitatively.
As he got closer to the source of the chaotic energy, the subspace showed not only despairing darkness but also traces of battle.
There were full of cracks and twisted traces in the space. They all seemed to be traces brought about by destructive swordsmanship.
Eventually, when he reached the source, Jin was able to face a woman.
It wasn't Valeria.
[It's been a long time... youngest.]
Runtia Lun Candle.
The woman Jin faced was his second elder sister.
